Term_JPReading: かんりしゅ/レギオミニストレーター
Summary: 創作世界と現実世界の両方に近い位置にある『超次元執筆空間(アトリエ)』から創作世界の管理を行っている、現実世界で言う"権限主"を総称したものに相当する存在。
Summary_EN: An entity equivalent to what would be called an "authority holder" in the real world — a collective term for those who administer the fictional worlds from the #ATELIER (the super-dimensional owners' space), a place positioned close to both the fictional world and the real world.

Term_JPReading: そうぞうしゅ/レギオーナー
Summary: 「フィジカル９」に所属し創作世界を創出・管理する、現実世界で言う"作者"に相当する存在。この創作世界「第８界」においてでは、この創作作品群を手掛ける作者の代理「ラジアン」が相当する。
Summary_EN: An entity belonging to "Physical 9" who creates and administers fictional worlds, equivalent to what would be called an "author" in the real world. In this fictional world, "#REGION.8," this role corresponds to "RadianN," the author's proxy who handles this group of creative works.

Term_JPReading: はかいしゅ/レギオミテーター
Summary: 創作世界と現実世界の両方に近い位置にある『超次元執筆空間(アトリエ)』から創作世界の整合を保っている、現実世界で言う"企画者"に相当する存在。『第８界』においては「ステラ」が担当しているが、他の７つの創作世界については「フィジカル９」の外部に担当者が存在するようだ。
Summary_EN: An entity equivalent to what would be called a "planner" in the real world, maintaining consistency across the fictional worlds from the #ATELIER (the super-dimensional owners' space), a place positioned close to both the fictional world and the real world. In "#REGION.8," this role is handled by "Srera'N," but for the other seven fictional worlds, there seem to be handlers outside of "Physical 9."

Term_JPReading: かんせいしゅ/ターミニストレーター
Summary: 『管理主』に相当するものの「フィジカル９」ら創造主とは反対の役割を有し、創作世界の破壊と廃棄を行う存在。本来は現在の創作世界に不要なものを『超次元執筆空間(アトリエ)』の住民の操作により創作世界から抹消するための立場であったはずが、最近はそれに相当する存在が『第８界』など創作世界の"内部"に出現しているらしく……
Summary_EN: An entity equivalent to the "Regioministrator," but with a role opposite to that of the Regiowners such as "Physical 9," responsible for the destruction and disposal of fictional worlds. This position was originally meant to erase things unnecessary to the current fictional world through the operations of the residents of the #ATELIER (the super-dimensional owners' space); however, it seems that recently, entities equivalent to this role have begun appearing "inside" fictional worlds such as "#REGION.8"...
